messages.subject: Error: too many open devices.
parts:
I created a Shiny App using a web address, such as "http://..../myApp". This address was published to more than 10 users. When many of them open the webpage, an error message is shown as "Error: too many open devices". I hereafter created several other address such as  "http://..../myApp1", and link the new address to the original one  "http://..../myApp". I don't see the error on my side. 

Now, my question is that, can we find a better solution for the error of too many open devices? 

Thanks very much for any kind help in advance!

Danni
